as_told.title: Disappearance of Jacobo Grinberg after lattice discovery

plain: A researcher who is not named, speaking on Jesse Michels' podcast, tells of a man named Jacobo Grinberg who vanished in Mexico. According to this guest, Grinberg disappeared in 1995, less than a month after the death of Andrija Puharich, the CIA scientist the episode is about. The guest draws on a documentary film made about Grinberg. Michels, the host, tells the story again on a later episode, though he dates it to 1994. He says the last note Grinberg wrote claimed he had "figured it out," and that Grinberg was never found. Michels credits the story partly to a researcher named Alex Gomez-Marin. They raise the timing because, if it is not a coincidence, it hints at a hidden link between the two men's fates.
